messages:
matt: :rotating_light: alert triggered — KV cache mem usage spiked on shard gpu-3, instance prod-dedicated-12. p50 latency climbed from 45ms to 420ms and tokens/sec dropped. Monitoring shows continuous-batching queues ballooning.

samir: Observed huge number of small batches stacking up. KV alloc arena fragmentation skyrocketed. CUDA OOMs started at 21:03 UTC.

elena: Copying logs: ```
E 21:03:12 cuda malloc failed: out of memory
W 21:03:15 kv_cache: arena alloc failed, requested 128MB
KV_STATS {used: 18.9GB, free_slots: 342, fragments: 1.2e6}
``` 

matt: Initial mitigation: disabled batching on model v2 for prod-dedicated-12 and reduced max_batch_size from 64 -> 16. Noticed immediate drop in allocation pressure.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-14T21:05:00Z — paging oncall @jenn (primary) and @kai (secondary). Severity: Sev2. Affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants (billing affected), 12% 4xx on streaming endpoints.

jenn: I'm on it, running nvtop on gpu-3 and tailing /var/log/redwood/runtime.log. Adding temp flag to enable arena compaction: `--kv-arena-compact-immediate`.

kai: Recommending also to flip kv_cache.compaction_threshold from 0.6 -> 0.4 and enable cudamalloc_arena_size=256MB for this instance as an emergency measure.

samir: After disabling batching, backlog drained. Latency improved to ~90ms but throughput reduced. We should avoid long-term loss for customers; plan to roll a hotfix that adjusts batching strategy rather than fully disabling.

matt: Customer impact: billing feed for BillingCorp showed delayed webhook retries; we contacted SE and ops. No data corruption reported. ETA for next update 30m. Assigned POC: @elena.

elena: Running ad-hoc compaction job now (script: `scripts/kv_compact.sh --shard gpu-3 --force`). Watching fragmentation counters.

opsbot: compaction job started at 21:18 UTC. Estimated 6m.

samir: Compaction completed, fragmentation down from 1.2e6 -> 80k. CUDA allocations stabilized. Memory reclaimed ~9GB.

jenn: Rolling a targeted config change to prod-dedicated-12: `kv.contbatch.window_ms=30, kv.max_batch_tokens=1024, kv.enable_prefix_cache=true` — will canary on 10% traffic.

matt: Canary started at 21:34 UTC. No regression so far. Observed batch sizes centering at 8-12 tokens; latency steady 60-80ms.

kai: Noted a related regression in recent runtime change: arena allocator changed default slab_size from 32MB -> 16MB in v1.3.2, which increases fragmentation for our long-lived KV entries. We should revert in next patch.

samir: Filed PR to revert slab_size and add auto-tuning logic: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2917 (link for context only).

elena: Will coordinate with platform to schedule an overnight canary of the allocator revert on dedicated pools. Also adding more aggressive monitoring for fragment_count and avg_free_chunk_size.

matt: Communication: Posted status update to #customer-status and pinged three affected accounts with mitigation notes and ETA for permanent fix ~48h.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: @jenn handing off to @kai at 23:00 UTC. Current state: stable; canary healthy; compaction completed.

jenn: Handoff note — watch for fragment_count > 200k or queue depth > 5000. If seen, escalate to samir and matt immediately. Logs: `/var/log/redwood/kv/*.log`.

kai: Ack. I'll take night watch, will keep reduced batching policy for the dedicated pool until allocator revert is deployed.

matt: Post-incident action items: 1) Revert slab_size change + add auto-tune (samir) 2) Add config guardrail to prevent full disable of batching unless explicit SRE approval (platform) 3) Improve compaction automation (elena) 4) Customer follow-up notes and RCA (product + eng).

elena: Scheduling follow-up RCA meeting at 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC. Inviting eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, support.

matt: Closing note: thanks everyone for quick triage. We'll convert this thread into a postmortem doc after RCA. :thumbsup:
